test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is the standard representation of quadratic equation

(x² + 1)(x - 1) = (x² - 3)(x + 3)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

(x2 + 1)(x - 1) = (x2 - 3)(x + 3)

⇒ x²(x - 1) + 1(x - 1) = x²(x + 3) - 3(x + 3)

⇒ x³ - x² + x - 1 = x³ + 3x² - 3x - 9

⇒ - 4x² + 4x + 8 = 0

⇒ 4x² - 4x - 8 = 0

**Hence, The Required equation is 4x² - 4x - 8 = 0.**
